tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya lo ha duṇḍa nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dha na rgyu zhing*/ a mra'i tshal du gshegs te byon nas/ a mra'i tshal du lus 'phags ri'i dbang po'i brag phug na bzhugs so// de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das lha ma yin dang*/ mi rnams ni bstan pa la gnod pa bgyid pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das lha ma yin dang*/ mi 'khor du gtogs pa'i bstan pa la yun ring par gnod pa'i phyir rgol ba'i dgra lags na/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis zhi bas mi 'dul na/ bdag la drag pos 'dul ba'i chos bstan du gsol/ theg pa'i chos dgra bsrung du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// lha'i dbang po khyod kyis thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i lcags mchu'i gzungs ma rungs pa 'joms pa/ don thams cad byed pa/ dam pa'i chos bsrung ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ dug thams cad 'jig pa/ mtshon thams cad rengs par byed pa/ theg pa'i chos dgra bsrung ba/ rkang med pa dang*/ rkang gnyis dang*/ rkang bzhi thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rkang gnyis thams cad skrag tu 'jug pa/ dgra thams cad phung bar byed pa/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ sbyin byed ma'i bu dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ bram ze dang*/ srin po dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ ro langs dang*/

bya'i gdon dang*/ srul po dang*/ nam gru dang*/ gnon po'i gdon dang*/ gnon po dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon dang*/ lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ gnod sbyin kyi gdon dang*/ dri za'i gdon dang*/ mi'am ci'i gdon dang*/ log 'dren kyi gdon dang*/ ma mo'i gdon phung bar byed pa/ zas kyi rigs mi mthun pa za ba phung bar byed pa/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ 'gro ba drag shul du spyod pa phung bar byed pa/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ mtshang 'bru ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa lcags kyi mchu'i gzungs/ nam mkha' lding drag po'i gzungs 'di zungs shig /bstan pa la gnod pa skrag par byed pa/ char drag po dang*/ ser ba drag po 'bebs par byed pa'i gzungs brjod par bya'o// tadya thā/ e ta me te/ pra me ti ti tra/ go le/ bo le bo sa se/ mod te/ bad te/ khā rang te/ khā ra ne kā na kā ne/ nā ga pu ga na/ mo na pra ti mo ne/ kā li bra ga le tsan te/ ma hā tsan te na pra ti tsan te/ pe ge so na/ go na mo hā/ pra mo ha/ ma hā mo ṭā/ pra mo tā/ na shā ni/ pran sha na dhi pa ni/ ba la kā ṇi pra ba la ga ṇi ni ra dya ni/ be ni da thā ni/ kro dha ni pri da kro dha ni/ ha na ha na bi ha na bi ha na/ sarba duṣṭa pra duṣṭan/ nā sha ya sarba a bha ya pra de hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di brjod pa tsam gyis phyogs kun tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ 'gul rab tu 'gul lo/ gnod pa thams cad kha bub tu brgyal lo// ske tshe dang yungs nag tu bsres la/ chu bo dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ ri bor gtor ro// de phyan chad char 'bebs par byed do// yang chu bo dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ rdzing bul ma/ 'bab chu/ mnyan dgur bu ram/ sbrang shing dang ra sha ka ra klu sman sna tshogs 'o ma la bsngags la gtor ro// de'i phyir ser ba chen po 'bebs so// yid bzlos bgyis te sprin la bltas la phyag bya zhing bzlas na/

ji ltar 'dod pa'i ser ba chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro// shes rab can gyis 'phags pa lcags mchu'i gzungs 'di zungs shig /chongs shig /rjod cig /gzhan la ma spel cig sbos shig /thun mong du min no// rgya mtsho'i chu rdo bzhin mi mngon par sbos shig /gzhan gyis mi thub pa drag po'i gzungs 'dis/ 'thab pa'am/ rtsod pa'am/ 'gyed pa'am/ gang du 'gro yang rung ste/ thams cad rgyal bar 'gyur ro// rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la byang bu gzugs so// sngags pa rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dang gang gis yid rtse gcig tu bya'o// dge slong pha dang*/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge tshul pha dang*/ dge tshul ma dang*/ dge bsnyen pha dang*/ dge bsnyen ma gang yang rung bas bstan pa la gnod pa bsrung ba'i phyir yid la zungs shig /chongs shig /de skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa dang*/ lha'i dbang po dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
